title: Text tabs
description: Large text tabs that are the page heading: 2–4 sibling views in display type, the current one bright and the others dim, no underline. Buttons switch at once; tabs with href are links, so the URL picks the view.
when: A page whose heading is a choice of 2–4 sibling views (Đang xử lý / Đã giao / Tất cả).
Views people link to or reload into: give the tabs an href (URL-driven).

instead.need: Sections of one record inside a page or card

a11y: WAI-ARIA tabs: tablist / tab / tabpanel, ←/→, Home, End move and the current tab is the only tab stop.
Buttons switch as focus moves; linked tabs (href) move focus only and Enter follows the link, so arrows never load a route.
The tabs sit in the page h1 by default (heading={false} when the page has its own h1); the panel is linked to its tab when children are given.
notes: Dim tabs use text-muted (≥ 4.5:1 in both themes): never lighter.
More than 4 views, or long names: Tabs or a CustomSelect, not TextTabs.
